data.one_liner: Flutter library for building interactive diagram editors with pan, zoom, and link support
data.what_it_does: Provides a DiagramEditor widget and a DiagramController to manage nodes and links on a canvas. Supports type‑safe custom data, serialization, and gesture callbacks.
use_when: Need a diagram or flow‑chart editor in a Flutter app
Want pan/zoom and link creation without writing custom gesture logic
Require type‑safe component data and custom serialization
avoid_when: You only need simple static diagrams
You prefer a fully declarative widget tree without a controller
You need integration with a state‑management solution that expects a provider or bloc
strengths: Extensible via callbacks and custom painters
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter (no pure Dart API)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, create DiagramController and DiagramEditor, no build_runner needed
